candidate_sentences.text: Flight-package revenue, the Group’s main product, fell to EUR 170.7 million from EUR 182.8 million, while other sales increased to EUR 25.4 million from EUR 20.9 million.

details.completeness_justification: All key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S2 (revenue decline), S4 (net loss), S5 (EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA), and S7 (loss per share). K2 is covered by S2 (passenger decline), S5 (EBITDA swing), S8 (goodwill impairment), and S12 (competitive pressures). K3 is covered by S19 (Kockar acquisition). K4 is covered by S14 (growth in Spain and long-haul travel). K5 is covered by S15 (adjusted EBITDA improvement) and S16 (operational improvements). K6 is covered by S17 (cash and debt position) and S18 (covenant breaches and waivers). K7 is covered by S13 (flight packages revenue decline and other sales growth).

coherence_issues.description: Sentence S15 states that adjusted EBITDA turned positive in the second half of the year, but does not explicitly connect this improvement to the previously mentioned factors (competition, oversupply, price pressure) that caused the overall deterioration. The logical bridge between the year-long challenges and the late-year recovery is implied but not made explicit.

candidate_sentences.text: Performance improved significantly late in the year: adjusted EBITDA was negative EUR 1.6 million in January–June but positive EUR 2.3 million in September–December.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative of overall deterioration followed by late-year improvement. Most relationships between causes, metrics, and outcomes are logically presented. The primary issue is a minor logical gap in S15 where the connection between the year-long challenges and the late-year recovery is implied but not explicitly stated. There are no self-contradictions, organizational problems, or significant repetitions. The arithmetic differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions because the candidate does not claim they are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
